cities.name: London
intro: London is Master Decker's home turf. We've stained decks in Old South, Byron, Masonville, Hyde Park, and right across the Forest City since 2014 — and most of our London work still comes from neighbour referrals.
London decks face hard freeze-thaw winters and full-sun summers that grey and crack unsealed wood fast. We clean, brighten, and stain to lock out moisture and hold colour for years, not months.

cities.name: St. Thomas
intro: We stain decks throughout St. Thomas and the surrounding Elgin County communities, from established neighbourhoods near downtown to newer subdivisions on the edge of town.
Our St. Thomas crews bring the same prep-first process we're known for in London — proper cleaning and brightening before any stain goes on, so the finish actually lasts through Ontario winters.

cities.name: Strathroy
intro: Strathroy homeowners trust Master Decker to bring weathered decks back to life with premium penetrating stains built for our climate.
Whether your cedar deck has greyed out or your pressure-treated boards are thirsty for protection, we clean, brighten, and stain so your deck looks sharp and sheds water for seasons to come.

cities.name: Woodstock
intro: We stain and seal decks across Woodstock and Oxford County, protecting your outdoor living investment from UV fade, moisture, and the freeze-thaw cycling that splits unprotected wood.
From a quick maintenance recoat to a full strip-clean-and-stain, our Woodstock deck staining service is backed by a written quote and a workmanship guarantee.

cities.name: Kitchener
intro: Master Decker has been active in the Kitchener-Waterloo corridor for years, staining decks on everything from mature lots in older neighbourhoods to recently built homes in the city's growing subdivisions.

Our Kitchener deck staining process starts with a thorough clean and wood brightener — the prep most contractors skip — so your stain bonds deep and holds its colour through the region's harsh winters.

cities.name: Waterloo
intro: We stain decks throughout Waterloo, from Uptown to Beechwood and Laurelwood, with premium oil and water-based penetrating stains chosen to suit your wood and sun exposure.
A properly stained deck in Waterloo's climate can last decades. We handle the cleaning, prep, and staining so you get a finish that protects the wood rather than just sitting on top of it.

cities.name: Cambridge
intro: Cambridge homeowners call Master Decker to restore and protect decks across Galt, Preston, and Hespeler with stains built for Ontario's freeze-thaw reality.
We clean, brighten, and saturate every board — including the end grain and railings most jobs miss — so your Cambridge deck holds its colour and sheds water for years.

cities.name: Guelph
intro: We bring our deck staining service to Guelph and the surrounding Wellington County communities, protecting wood decks from the UV and moisture that quietly age an unsealed surface.
From heritage homes in the city core to newer builds on the edges of town, our Guelph deck staining is prep-first, written-quote, and guarantee-backed.

cities.name: Hamilton
intro: Master Decker stains decks across Hamilton, from the mountain to the escarpment communities and into Ancaster, Dundas, and Stoney Creek.
Hamilton decks take prevailing winds, road grit, and hard freeze-thaw cycling. Our cleaning, brightening, and premium penetrating stains are built to stand up to all of it.

cities.name: Brantford
intro: We stain and seal decks throughout Brantford and Brant County, reviving tired, greyed wood and protecting newer decks before the damage starts.
Our Brantford deck staining service includes a full clean and wood brightener treatment so the stain penetrates properly — the difference between a finish that lasts and one that peels by spring.
